title: Tenth Coldain Ring War / Narandi
summary: Defend the Coldain through three giant sieges and stop Narandi's escape.
overview: Give Sentry Badain the ninth ring and declaration to begin the war briefing. Follow Aldikar's instructions and use Scout Zrelik to direct the allied forces.
The war advances through recruit, warrior and veteran sieges. Each siege advances after four of its designated leaders are defeated, then Narandi enters the battlefield.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Intercept advancing giants and keep pressure off Aldikar.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Keep the allied leadership alive while the raid covers the invasion routes.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Prioritize the designated siege leaders while stopping other giants from overrunning the defenders.

phases.label: First siege
phases.description: Stop recruits and defeat four captains.

phases.label: Second siege
phases.description: Defeat warriors, their priest support and four generals.

phases.label: Third siege
phases.description: Defeat veterans, high priests and four warlords.

phases.label: Narandi
phases.trigger: Two minutes after the final siege clears
phases.description: Intercept Narandi before he escapes. After killing him, follow Aldikar's instruction to return the head with the ring.

sections.title: Failure and recovery
paragraphs: Aldikar's death before the victory stage ends the war in defeat. Narandi has both an escape route and a later timeout, so do not postpone engaging him.
